requirements.statement: Machine records shall use versioned schemas with explicit identifiers, enums, nullability, references, and compatibility rules.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Semantic validators shall reject false PASS, missing evidence, superseded authority, broken reciprocal links, unapproved destructive actions, restricted publication leakage, and manifest drift.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: Must-run lifecycle rules shall use hooks, CI, policy, permissions, or runtime gates when supported, with pinned examples and fail-closed behavior for malformed input.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
